REMOVAL SERVICE POINT
<<A>> CONVERTIBLE TOP BYPASS SWITCH REMOVAL
1. Depress lower clips.
2. While holding lower clip, push the lower front of the switch 
past the lower clip [approximately 5 mm (0.2 inch)].
3. Depress upper clip.
4. While holding upper clip, jiggle and slide switch out.
